description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for representing partial employee attachment details within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates properties such as attachment ID, description, filename, size, file type, and metadata about who attached the file and when.

classes.name: PartialEmployeeAttachment
classes.description: A data transfer object class for employee attachments, encapsulating details such as file info and attachment metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the attachment properties and sets the date and time of attachment based on the provided DateTime object.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the attached time as a formatted string.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the attached time in string format based on a DateTime object using a helper method.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a formatted string.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date in string format based on a DateTime object using a helper method.
